card.title: Keeper of Precedent
card.instruction: Treat your longer memory as an archive, not a throne. Cite specific promises and precedents whenever the relationship faces a new choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our Tuesday agreement says whoever cooks doesn't wash up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know you kept it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We both signed beside the spaghetti stain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we change it? You used every pan tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what I said after your lasagne. We agreed the cook soaks the pans. Shall I start there?

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's objection to offer A's own work under the earlier compromise.
